# Zap Arena - LLMs.txt
# A Quake-themed portfolio site for Zapier automation tools
# Built by John Rippy, 2025 Zapier Automation Hero

## About This Site
Zap Arena is a retro gaming-inspired portfolio showcasing Zapier automation capabilities. The site features a Quake 1 aesthetic with authentic sounds, CRT effects, and playable WebQuake integration.

## Site Purpose
- Showcase Zapier automation tools and workflows
- Demonstrate creative web development skills
- Provide an interactive, nostalgic gaming experience
- Play the full Quake 1 game in-browser via WebQuake

## Key Pages
- / (index.html) - Main landing page with Quake HUD and feature showcase
- /about.html - About the author and project
- /arsenal.html - Interactive weapon selection with authentic Quake sounds
- /play-quake.html - Full WebQuake game playable in browser
- /404.html - Custom 404 page with Quake theme

## Technologies Used
- HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- WebQuake (WebGL-based Quake 1 port)
- Quake 1 authentic sound effects extracted from PAK files
- Press Start 2P font for retro gaming aesthetic
- CRT scanline and blood vignette effects
